title: a Smptomatic Bacteriuria in Pregnancy
brief_summary: Asymptomatic bacteriuria (ASB) is defined as the presence of at least 105 colony-forming units (CFU)/ml of 1 or 2 bacterial species in clean-voided midstream urine sample from an individual without symptoms of UTI
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 1\. Pregnant females 2. Non-symptomatic females.

Exclusion Criteria:

* 1\. Patients taking antibiotics in the last two weeks. 2. Symptomatic UTI. 3. Suspected urinary tract abnormalities. 4. Urinary catheterization. 5. Renal dialysis.
